items.item_text: Board certified or board eligible in Family Medicine or Medicine-Pediatrics
Unrestricted California medical license or license eligible

Bring your expertise to UCLA Health and build a rewarding primary care practice in Malibu, supported by the resources, clinical excellence and reputation of one of the nation’s leading health systems. UCLA Health offers physicians the opportunity to build lasting patient relationships while providing high-quality, community-based care.

We are seeking a board-certified/board-eligible Family Medicine or Med-Peds physician to join our Family Medicine, Internal Medicine and Pediatrics practice in Malibu. This opportunity is ideal for a physician who enjoys full-spectrum primary care across all ages, including pediatric patients, with opportunities to support Immediate Care needs as part of the practice. You’ll build lasting relationships with patients and families while benefiting from access to UCLA Health’s extensive network of specialists and clinical resources.
Learn more about the UCLA Health Malibu practice
Provide full-spectrum primary care across all ages, including pediatric care, with opportunities to support Immediate Care needs
Build lasting relationships with a diverse community of patients and families
Access UCLA Health’s extensive network of specialists and clinical resources
Practice within an integrated environment supported by Epic
Grow your career within a nationally recognized health system

UCLA Health offers a comprehensive benefits program designed to support your health, well-being and future. Benefits may include medical, dental and vision coverage; retirement plans, including pension benefits; paid time off; malpractice coverage; leadership-approved CME support; relocation assistance; and Public Service Loan Forgiveness eligibility.
Comfortable providing full-spectrum primary care across all ages, including pediatric care and partial Immediate Care coverage

Malibu offers a distinctive Southern California lifestyle, combining coastal beauty, outdoor recreation and a close-knit community within reach of greater Los Angeles. Nestled between the Pacific Ocean and Santa Monica Mountains, the area is known for its beaches, hiking trails and scenic coastline, with convenient access to nearby communities including Pacific Palisades, Santa Monica, Calabasas, Westlake Village and the greater Westside. It’s an exceptional setting to build meaningful relationships with your patients while enjoying one of Southern California’s most unique communities.
